verdict.rationale: Financial Connections emits webhook events, such as a new account being linked or a balance, ownership or transaction refresh completing. Developers can write their own code to act on these events, and the use-cases page mentions agent-oriented balance and transaction monitoring via the Link CLI. However, there is no evidence of a rules engine or any way to define event-triggered actions without building the logic yourself. Missing for 10: native rule definition/configuration, automatic action execution on events, documented event-to-action workflows, independent corroboration.
